source: Sandell et al., Nanomaterials 10, 670 (2020), Table 2 and Eq. (2) (Europe PMC full text PMC7221886). FDTR at room temperature. G is the combined (series) boundary conductance of metal/PMMA and PMMA/native-SiO2/Si: 1/G = 1/G_metal-PMMA + 1/G_PMMA-Si. Effective film conductance G_eff(t) = 1/(t/kPMMA + 1/G). Total experimental error 10%.
units: G in MW m^-2 K^-1, kPMMA in W m^-1 K^-1
